tratti:
**Ooze Cube.** The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creatura that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf e ha svantaggio a the tiro salvezza. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover. A creatura entro 1,5 metri of the cube can take an action to pull a creatura o object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, e the creatura making the attempt subisce 10 (3d6) danni acido. The cube can hold only one Large creatura o up to four Medium o smaller creatures inside it at a time.

**Transparent.** Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creatura that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.

**Engulf.** The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large o smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creatura's space, the creatura must make a tiro salvezza su Destrezza CD 12. se supera il tiro salvezza, the creatura can choose to be pushed 1,5 metri back o to the side of the cube. A creatura that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed tiro salvezza. se fallisce, the cube enters the creatura's space, e the creatura subisce 10 (3d6) danni acido e is engulfed. The engulfed creatura can't breathe, is trattenuto, e subisce 21 (6d6) danni acido at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creatura moves with it. An engulfed creatura can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creatura escapes e enters a space of its choice entro 1,5 metri of the cube.

**Artigli (Hag Form Only).** Attacco con arma da mischia: +7 al tiro per colpire, portata 1,5 m, un bersaglio. Colpito: 13 (2d8 + 4) danni taglienti.

**Change Shape.** The hag magically polymorphs into a Small o Medium female humanoid, o back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing o carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

**Etereo.** The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, o vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.

**Nightmare Haunting (1/Day).** While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A Protezione dal Bene e dal Male spell cast on il bersaglio prevents this contact, as does a Cerchio Magico. As long as the contact persists, il bersaglio has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least 1 hour, il bersaglio gains no benefit from its rest, e its punto ferita maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). If this effect reduces il bersaglio's punto ferita maximum to 0, il bersaglio dies, e if il bersaglio was evil, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to il bersaglio's punto ferita maximum lasts until removed by the Ristorare Superiore spell o similar magic.

A humanoid host can carry only one slaad egg to term at a time. Over three months, the egg moves to the chest cavity, gestates, e forms a slaad tadpole. In the 24-hour period before giving birth, the host starts to feel unwell, its speed is halved, e it ha svantaggio a tiri per colpire, prove di caratteristica, e tiri salvezza. tratti: **Petrifying Gaze.** When a creatura that puo' vedere the medusa's eyes starts its turn entro 9 metri of the medusa, the medusa can da forza it to make a tiro salvezza su Costituzione CD 14 if the medusa non e' incapacitato e puo' vedere the creatura. If the tiro salvezza fails by 5 o more, the creatura is instantly pietrificato. Otherwise, a creatura that fails the save begins to turn to stone e is trattenuto. The trattenuto creatura must repeat the tiro salvezza at the end of its next turn, becoming pietrificato on a failure o ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creatura is freed by the Ristorare Superiore spell o other magic. Unless surprised, a creatura can avert its eyes to avoid the tiro salvezza all'inizio del suo turno. If the creatura does so, it can't see the medusa fino all'inizio del suo prossimo turno, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creatura looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface entro 9 metri of it e in an area of bright Luce, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.
azioni:

tratti:
**Bound.** The Scudo guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian e its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, e the guardian knows the distance e direction to the amulet. If the guardian is entro 18 metri of the amulet's wearer, half of any danni the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

**Rigenerazione.** The Scudo guardian regains 10 punti ferita all'inizio del suo turno if it has at least 1 punto ferita.

**Spell Storing.** A spellcaster who wears the Scudo guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4° livello o lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored entro the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer o when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast o a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

**acido Absorption.** Whenever the golem is subjected to danni acido, it subisce no danni e instead regains a number of punti ferita equal to the danni acido dealt.

**Berserk.** Whenever the golem starts its turn with 60 punti ferita o fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creatura it puo' vedere. If no creatura is near enough to move to e attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed o regains all its punti ferita.

**Immutable Form.** The golem is immune to any spell o effect that would alter its form.

**Magic Resistenza.** The golem ha vantaggio a tiri salvezza contro incantesimi e altri effetti magici.

While in bat form, the vampire non puo' parlare, its walking speed is 1,5 metri, e it has a flying speed of 9 metri. Its statistics, other than its size e speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, e it can't pass through water. It ha vantaggio a Strength, Dexterity, e Constitution tiri salvezza, e it is immune to all non magico danni, except the danni it takes from sunlight.

**Misty Escape.** When it drops to 0 punti ferita outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling privo di sensi, provided that it isn't in sunlight o running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 punti ferita in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, e it must portata its resting place entro 2 hours o be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralizzato until it regains at least 1 punto ferita. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 punti ferita, it regains 1 punto ferita.

**Rigenerazione.** The vampire regains 20 punti ferita all'inizio del suo turno if it has at least 1 punto ferita e isn't in sunlight o running water. If the vampire subisce danni radiosi o danni from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

**Harmed by Running Water.** The vampire subisce 20 danni acido if it ends its turn in running water.

**Stake to the Heart.** If a perforanti weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire e' incapacitato in its resting place, the vampire is paralizzato until the stake is removed.

**Antimagic Cone.** The dreadnought's eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the Campo Anti-Magia spell, in a 45 metri cone. all'inizio di ciascun suo turno, it decides which way the cone faces. The cone doesn't function while the eye is closed o while the dreadnought is accecato.

**Astral Entity.** he dreadnought can't leave the Astral Plane, nor can it be banished o otherwise transported out of that plane.

**Demiplanar Donjon.** Anything the dreadnought swallows is transported to a Semipiano that can be entered by no other means except a Desiderio spell o the dreadnought's Bite e Donjon Visit. A creatura can leave the Semipiano only by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the Cambio di Piano spell. The Semipiano resembles a stone cave roughly 1,0 metri in diameter with a ceiling 30 metri high. Like a stomach, it contains the remains of past meals. The dreadnought can't be harmed from entro the Semipiano. If the dreadnought dies, the Semipiano disappears, e everything inside it appears around the dreadnought's corpse. The Semipiano is otherwise indestructible.
